summary: The dossiers hold up, from Hinkle, Attucks and Reggie's 8.9 to Haliburton's return, Zubac and Hinkle on Dec 11. Ten fixes went in place, including New Castle's capacity (about 7,300, not 9,300). Live checks confirmed Puma (signed Oct 2024) and found that Milktooth briefly closed in 2026. For the brief: call Oct 30 the only confirmed home date, drop 'Hali 1' and reconcile the royal-blue hex.
